evidence: Changes block and undo data write handling in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to explicitly flush buffers and trigger a clean fatal shutdown on failure.
rationale: Prevents unclean node termination when writing block and undo data to a full disk. Instead of triggering an unhandled exception and `std::terminate` during block storage unwinding, write errors are caught explicitly to log the failure and initiate an orderly fatal shutdown.
